price_snapshots.csv.convention: SPREAD and TOTAL and MONEYLINE values are home-perspective: positive spread values mean the HOME team is favoured by that many points (verified empirically in results/market.json convention_check). MONEYLINE rows carry home win probability. The origination-lab slate's 'our_spread' is display convention and is negated on ingest (verified against our_home_win_prob).

columns.our_fair_line: our number at origination (home margin / game total / home win prob). Status: ours-reproducible
columns.our_fair_price_american: our american price where the engine publishes one (moneyline rows)
columns.market_open_line: market's opening number. BLANK today - no source (PS-F-01)
columns.market_close_line: market's closing number (probability for MONEYLINE rows, normalised over both prices). Status: archived-unverified
columns.difference: our_fair_line - market_close_line in difference_unit; computed, inherits the weaker input status
columns.difference_unit: points (home margin) | points | home win probability
columns.official_source_url: filled only for rows whose values were checked against an official source

price_snapshots_props.csv.grain: one row per (season, week, player_id, market)

columns.settle_vs_our_line: win | loss | push of actual vs our_line (computed)

results_feed.csv.grain: one row per REG game 2023+ (1,088 rows)

columns.away_score / home_score: official digits where score_status starts verified-official; archived digits where archived-unverified; blank where missing
columns.spread_close_home / total_close / home_m: archived closing numbers (archived-unverified; official odds do not exist, PS-F-08)
columns.ats_home_result / total_over_result / ml: win | loss | push vs the closing number (computed; inherits the line status)
columns.official_source_url: the official page/PDF the score was checked against (verified rows only)
